tei:div.tei:p: tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /

mi sdug nyid kyi zhal nas hūm̐ spro zhing*/ / rgod/ thal bas sku la byugs pa nyid/ / sgeg bdag med lhan cig mnyam sbyor zhing*/ /dga' ba thabs shes gnyis bā+o la ka k+ko la gnyis snyoms 'jug pas/ / rtog pa'i rba rlabs med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni bzhad cing gnag / drag shul/ g.yas pa la ni kun da mtshungs/ / zhi ba/ g.yon pa dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ / sgeg pa/ steng ma'i zhal ni rnam par gtsigs/ / kṛṣ+ṇa/ spyan ni nyi shu rtsa bzhis che/ / drag shul/ lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba bzhin/ / drag 1snying rje'i nyams gsung na rtsa rgyud du tshul mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas kha bskang te/ 'di'i/ rnam dag ya gi 'dra'o gsung 3g.yas rdo rje ral gri 'dzin pa dang*/ / mda' dang de bzhin 'khor lo nyid/ /de bzh-in chang 'dzin/ gshor dang dbyig pa dang | | rtse gsum dang ni lcags kyu nyid/ /g.yon brgyad/ na dril bu pad+mar bcas// gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'phyar zhing*/ /thod pa dang ni rin chen nyid/ /sdigs mdzub zhags pa de bzhin no/ / ba spu'i khung bu las sangs rgyas sprin gyi 'od zer dam tshig sems dpa'i snying kha'i hūm̐ las/ ltar/ /kun tu sna tshogs spro spros pa la dga' na ye shes pa gzhug pa sogs yan lag bzhi rdzogs par bya/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar du byas la bzlas/ mi dga' na 'di tsam bya/ bar ba de sgrib pa sbyangs nas tshur bsdud pa/ bya/ /de ltar cho ga sna tshogs thig le bcu drug las sa bon bcu drugade las lha mo'i gsang gnas su bcu drug bskyed de/ mngal skyes/ kyis/ / rtsa rgyud dang mi mthun pa'i sgrub thabs dkar mo la sogs de nas dgod/ / shar gyi re'u mig la dkar mo zhi ba'i gdong zhes 'byung dkar de nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras ta thā spyan drangs zhal du zhugs khu bar gyur sku brgyud nas thig le bcu drug nas sa bon bcu drug gi bar ro// mo kha dog dkar mo zhal gcig ste/ / phyag bzhi na gzhu dang mda' ni 'gengs pa mchog

/thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang*/ /de bzhin rdo rje gri gug nyid/ / lhor chom rkun ma ni kha dog dmar | | dang po gnyis na/ 'khor lo lcags kyu 'dzin mar brjod/ / 'og ma gnyis thod pa dang ni cang te'u nyid/ /gsal ba'i gzugs can dgod par bya/ / g.yung mo'i ming rmongs byed ma ni sku mdog gnag / rgyud phyi ma las 'di nub na yod/ de bzhin thod pa lcang lo can du byas pa yod/ pa dang ni gshol/ / 'di mnyam sbyor gyi dgongs pa dang gcig pas rgyud phyi ma ltar yin/ glus bskul ba gang nas bskul kyang 'dra gsung ngo*/ sa la zlog pa nyid dang yang*/ / g.yas pas rtse gsum 'phyar ba'o/ / 'di yod na 'og gi g.yung mo med/ ro byang du/ langs ma ni dkar ser mtshungs/ /lag pa g.yas/ dag na chang dang g.yon/ chu/ / g.yas ral gri dang ni g.yon/ thod pa nyid/ /mdzes ma'i gzugs can bsgom par bya | | shar lhor puk+ka sī ni kha dog ser/ / g.yas dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma dang*// g.yon sha yis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ / g.yon rin chen dang ni g.yas mchog sbyin nyid | | bden bral du gdol pa mo ni sngo mdog mtshungs/ /de bzhin spyi bor lag pa gnyis kyis/ rlung gi gos 'dzin ma/ / g.yon gzhan pa dag gis thod pa dang*/ /de bzhin pad+ma dkar po nyid/ / byang shar du g.yung mo 'di pra mo ha'i ming yin pa gong ma bsgoms na mi dgos snga ོ dang dkar ba'i mdog /rdo rje dang ni lcags kyu 'dzin/ /g.yon pas thod pa 'dzin pa ste/ /gzhan pas rlung gi gos 'dzin ma/ / rlung du ghasma rī ni ljang ser mtshungs/ /rdo rje me thab dgra s+t+wa'i lag / g.yon thod pa tshil bus yongs gang ba | | g.yas pas mi 'jigs sbyin byed ma/ / 'di nub tu 'ong ri khrod ma ni dkar mdog mtshungs/ / g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa'i lag / g.yas rdo rje de bzhin zhags pa nyid/ /sna tshogs can ni bsgom par bya/ / brgyad po de las thod pa brgyad kyi nang na rang rang gi rnam dag gi rtags ro hi ta dang phag nyid dang*/

/rus sbal de bzhin lto 'phye nyid | | seng ge de bzhin stag nyid dang*/ /wa dang dge slong nyid rnams ni/ /de ltar dkar mo la sogs pa'i/ /thod pa brgyad du cho ga bzhin/ / bsam/ rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /sgeg pa la sogs ro dang ldan/ / phyi'i 'phar ma'i sgo bzhir rta yi dhaṃ/ gzugs dang phag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gi gdong*/ khyi gdong de bzhin seng ge ma/ / bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo ma bzhi/ lcags kyu ma la sogs pa bzhi'i sgo ma bzhi'i phyag mtshan mtha' gnyis spang ba zhal bzhi ma la phyag bzhi ma/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ / 1 mtshams bzhi na 2 oṃ badz+ra waṃ s+ye hūm̐ 3ming yig dang po brgyad nas bzlas sngags yi ge lngas khyad par byas pa'o| | gling bu dang ni oṃ badz+ra bi ni hūm̐/ pi wang dang*/ / mu kun+da de mu ku na dang mri taṃ ga rdza rnga ste | | phyag gnyis ma la dang po/ zhal gcig ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan | | 1'di phyag mtshan bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo ma'i 'og ma gnyis spangs pa sa bon dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ2sgo ma'i zhal gyi mdog 3dbus nag mo g.yas/ dkar g.yon/ ser lta bu dang*/ /de bzhin steng du rta gdong ljang*/ / dbus ser mo g.yas/ nag mo g.yon/ dkar mtshungs dang || de bzhin steng du phag gdong dmar/ / dbus dmar zhing g.yas/ gnag dang g.yon| dkar mtshungs shing*/ /de bzhin steng du khyi gdong ser/ / dbus ljang dang g.yas| gnag dang g.yon/ dkar ba'i gdong*/ /steng du 'od/ 'bar ba'i seng ge gdong | | thams cad skra ni gyen du 'bar/ /g.yon brkyangs pa yis ro mnan cing | | spyan gsum khro zhing sgeg pa dang*/ / bzlas pa'i sngags brtag pa brgyad pa na yod rgod pa'i bzhin ni bsgom par bya/ /he ru ka bskyed pa gsum pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// // gdan bzhi'i gzhan gyi gdan gyi rab tu byed pa gsum pa dang cha mthun par bstan ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha bcu gsum gyi/

sgrub thabs ni/ /rdo rje gtso bo rgyal po nyon/ /gnyis med phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i/ ye shes chos dbyings rtog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba/ chos ldan rang gi snying khar oṃ hūm̐ swāhā dmigs la des lha dang bla ma spyan drangs nas puṣ+pa'i mu dra la sogs pas pū tsa/ bshags/ bsngo| skyabs su 'gro/ lus dbul/ lam bsten/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas ye shes tshogs te/ 'di bla ma gong ma sbyor gsung ste phyi ltar sbyar ro/ / pa'i/ /gnyis kyi dngos po spangs pa rnal 'byor pas kyang lam du byaid tsam na gnyis dang bral bar rtogs/ yis/ /rnal 'byor ni bskyed rdzogs/ kun sogs dang por ni/ / nangs par sad pa dang dag pa sngags kyi rkyen gyis stong par bsgom pa de ye shes mkha' 'gro nyid sgyu ma tsam du bsgom gyi snang ba mi 'gog gsum ni gdon par bya/ / dbyings kyi swa bhā wa rang rig dag pa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ / nai rāt+ma lha bco lnga dag pa so so/ lus ngag yid gsum dag pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa/ ye shes kyi dag pa ngag badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma lha bcu gsum gyi dag pa/ yo ga shud+dhāḥ shes rab dbyings thabs dbyer med/ sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ yid/he ru ka'i dag pa/ de ltar dag pa gsum 'don par/ byas nas rnal 'byor pas/ / shū n+ya tā bsgom pa yang ni bsam gtan de nyid bya/ /yid dang rjes mthun gnas rnams su/ /de nas rang mkha' 'gro ma'i/ bsam gtan brtsam par bya/ / nyal ba sgyu ma lta bur/ ldang ba des langs la snying kha'i hūm̐ las tshogs zhing spyan drangs/ lngas mchod/ bshags pa sogs tshad med bzhi/ ye shes tshogs gsog bya'o/ / bla re stan sbyangs pa/ yang ni bri ba nyid/ /sna tshogs gos ni 'phyang ba dang*/ /'phan dang rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang*/ /phyogs bcu gnas ni thams cad du/ /dri zhim me tog sna tshogs dang*/ /de bzhin dri yi dkyil 'khor du/

/ byas la me tog yang dgod/ bdag rang skad cig gi rnal 'byor gyi mdun du dbugs dbyung rngub las ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'khor bcas bskyed la/ de nas bdag rang de la thim la ye shes pa dgug ska da cig ma/ gcig pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag gi lus ni ye shes mkha' 'gro mar/ bsam par bya/ /blo gros ldan pas sngar lha bskyed pa'i sngon du yi dam gyi lhar/ mchod nas/ / bdun rnam dag bya/ de nas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma ni bdag bskyed/ gzung*/ / bdag gi mdun du ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa bstan de ltar cho ga 'di ltar/ sna tshogs ni/ / gdan bzhi pa'i rgyud nas 'dir lag pa'i phyag rgya la sogs pas srung 'khor bsgom pa yod/ nges par bsgom pa nyid du bya// oṃ hūm̐ swāhā las ye shes rgya mtsho'i mkha' 'gro ma/ ri bo'i ri rab kyi rtser/ mgor/ / srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa de'i nang du suṃ las ri rab bsgom/ sa bon 'di dag kyang rang gi sa bon las 'byung gsung ngo*// phyogs mtshams/ bzhi kha dog bzhir ni bsam/ / de'i steng du 'byung ba rim rtseg gi khang pa'i nang du/ de bzhin gser gyi rgyan byung dang*/ / gser las byas pa'i gzhal yas khang rin po ches sbras pa/ rin chen bdun asma garba dang in+d+ra nī la sogs/ gyis rnam par spras/ / g.yer kha 'bar ba'i phreng bas ni/ /'dod pa kun tu rgyas par ni/ / gdan bzhi par 'dir dang po bcom ldan 'das ma bsgom ste/ de nas de la dam tshig gi mu dra bstan nas de nas bskyed pa yod| gnas ni phyogs bzhi dbus dang*/ lnga ru seng ge yi/ / byang shar la sogs pa sbrul gdan ni bsgom pa nyid du bya/ / dbus su nyi thams cad kyi thun mong gi gdan/ ma'i dkyil 'khor bsams nas ni/ / steng du gdugs ni dkar pos rnam par spras/ / slob dpon bha wa pas sngon la dam tshig sems dpa' bsgom nas de nas ye shes sems ma dbugs kyis phyung la bstim zhes bshad do/

/ bdag gi dbugs kyis nyi ma dang gdugs kyi bar du bdag gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las dbugs phyir 'byung ba'i dus su sna bug g.yas nas ye shes mkha' 'gro/ phyung nas ni/ /dbus su seng ge'i gdan dbus ma'i steng du/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhal gsum ma la phyag drug nyid | | sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis gnas/ / lha mo rnams rjes su chags pa'i brdar/ ma bcings skra yis mdzes pa dang*//sangs rgyas lnga yis dpral bar/ rnam par brgyan/ kha dog sngon mo 'jigs chen mo/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ / zhal gsum rgod dang khro ba sgeg pa dang*/ / spyir lha mo la nyams gsum de las gsungs pa med/ spyan gsum gsal ba'i gzugs can ma/ /sgra cher rgod dang gtsigs ma ni/ /gos ni dmar pos shin tu mdzes/ / g.yas kyi dang po steng du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga nyid dang*/ / gnyis pa la ni dgra s+t+wa nyid/ /gsum pa la ni rdo rje nyid/ /g.yon dang po/ na de bzhin dril bu'i sgra//gnyis pa la ni lhung bzed nyid/ /gsum par de bzhin ral gri 'dzin// 'od zer 'bar ba du ma dang*/ /dbus su gzhal yas khang dbus su seng ge'i steng du nyi ma la| mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mdun du ni/ / rdo rje mkha' 'gro oṃ las bdag gis dbugs kyis phyung nas oṃ a swāhā bzlas pa'i sngags/ ni/ kha dog dkar mo shin tu mdzes/ /ma bcings pa yi skra yis brgyan/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang*/ /sgeg pa'i ro dang ldan pa dang*/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos ky-is brgyan | | phyag gnyis kyis ni rnam par spras/ / g.yon rnal thams cad 'dra/ 'byor lhung bzed g.yas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bsgom bya/ / phyogs g.yon bskor ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i/ byang gi cha la ni/ / oṃ ā swāhā/ a las bdag gi dbugs las phyung ba ni/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung*/ /btso ma gser gyi 'od lta bu// rnal 'byor lhung bzed kha ṭ+wāṃ ga

/ma bcings skra yis rnam par brgyan/ /yan lag sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ / 'jigs pa'i mkha' 'gro zhes bya bsgom/ / a srog med ye shes nub kyi cha la ni// yang ni ro langs ma phyung nas/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung*/ kha dog sngon po shin tu mdzes/ /rnal 'byor lhung bzed kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /ma bcings pa yi skra yis brgyan/ /lus la sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i stod g.yogs sogs/ gos kyis brgyan/ /ye shes lho yi cha la ni/ /gdol pa mo ni dmar mo ltar// a la thig les brgyan pa/ rnal 'byor lhung bzed kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /ma bcings pa yi skra yis brgyan | | phyag gnyis ma la zhal gcig ma/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan | | rgyud bde ba chen pos yongs gang gzugs dang gzi brjid ldan/ /'di ni rnal 'byor pas bsgom bya/ / mtshams g.yas bskor dbang ldan lha mo seng ge ṛ/ ma/ / gdong ni seng ger bsam par bya/ / phyed gzugs ma dkar dang ser ba lta bur ni/ / klu dbang sbrul 'khyil ba'i/ stan la g.yas brkyangs gnas/ / g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu g.yon| sdigs mdzub zhags/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /'od zer 'bar ba du ma yis/ /lus ni 'bar bar bsgom par bya/ / mer ni stag mo zhes bya ba/ /rin ṝ/ chen bdun po der nyi ma/ mchog gi gdan/ / phyag gnyis sngo dmar bar 'ong*/ zhing dkar dang mtshungs/ / shin tu mdzes pa'i gos dang rgyan gyis ma bcings pa'i skra dang sbrul gyis/ brgyan pa dang*/ /'bar ba'i g.yas/ rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ /de bzhin g.yon| sdigs mdzub zhags pa nyid/ /'od zer 'bar ba du mas ni/ /lus ni 'bar bar bsgom par bya/ /bden bral lha l̥ las/ mo wa gdong ma/ /sgra cher rgod dang 'jigs pa mo/ /me ma he/ sha'i gdan dang yang dag ldan/ /dmar phyed gzugs| zhing gnag pa'i kha dog ma/ /lus la shin tu mdzes gos dang*/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni rnam par spras/

/lcags kyu zhags pa sdigs mdzub ma/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /rlung du l̥̄/ g.yung mo 'ug pa 'i gdong*/ ma/ /ser dang dmar sngan por 'ong*/ po'i kha dog ma/ /klu yi gdan la gnas pa dang*/ / sbrul de nyid rgyun du rab tu brtag /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gnas/ / g.yas/ lcags kyu g.yon| zhags pa sdigs mdzub ma/ /'od zer 'bar ba du ma yi/ / 'od zer/ thams cad kyis ni lha mo/ thams cad 'bar/ /mkha' 'gro ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ ma brgyad dbus su ste/ /phyi rol gyi ni lha mo/ de ltar dgod pa'i rim bltas nas/ / phyi rol bzhi po'o| | phyi nas gnas ni rab brtag bya/ /shar du gyi sgor/ mkha' 'gro'i rgyal phu las| ma dbang*/ /phyag gnyis dang ni mdog dkar ma/ /yi dwags srog song ba'i/ stan la gnas pa dang*/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang*/ /skra ni grol zhing drag mo dang

| | me ni 'bar ba'i 'od lta bu/ / thal sbyar gyi khar ni lag pa bcug nas ni// sgra cher rgod dang de bzhin 'od/ 'bar/ /byang du mar me rgyal phaiṃ/ mo dbang*/ kha dog ser mo drag shul ma/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can mche ba/ gtsigs pa can/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /rab tu song ba'i ro/ stan la gnas/ / 'bar ba'i me ni lta bu'i 'od/ /thal mo gnyis kyi lag pa ni// mgo bo'i steng du mar me bzhin/ /nub tu lha mo 'jigs byed phraiṃ ma/ kha dog dmar mo 'jigs pa mo | | rab tu song ba'i ro/ stan la gnas/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan// dgra bo'i khrag rak+ta/ gi srad bu rgyun/ lag pa yi/ /snyim pa bkang na/ sa khrag ni 'thung bar byed | | me yi 'bar ba'i 'od drag mo/ /lha mo gtso mo bsgrub bya'i khrag 'jib byed ma'o | | lho ru g.yo ldan phraṃ las/ ma zhes pa/ de thams cad la dang por oṃ mthar swāhā bzlas pa/ kha dog nag mo lta bu'i 'od/ /rab tu song ba'i stan la gnas/ /grol ba'i skra yis rnam par brgyan/ /gos ni dmar po shin tu mdzes/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang*/ /sdigs mdzub dang ni gtun shing gdan bzhi pa na bcu gsum po thams cad kyi lus brda ngag gnyis ka yong*/ brtag pa bdun par ngag brda tsam las med/ lag /thams cad sems ni rmongs par byed/ /'bar ba'i me yi 'od drag mo/ /thams cad rigs pas thams cad bsgom/ / spros pa la dga' na ye shes pa gzhug pa sogs yan lag bzhi rdzogs bya/ de nas bzlas pa bya/ thun mtshams su khang pa mi bsdu bar spyod lam bya'o/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma lha bcu gsum po bsgom pa de la 'di rnams kyi/ gzugs gnyis sngon du ston pa 'am/ sogs snga brjod| mdun du ni/ / phrad tsam na/ dam tshig so so'i phyag rgya ste gdan bzhir bstan/ de bzhin bstan par bya/ / des byin gyis rlobs/ 'di rdzogs pa'i rim pa tsaṇ+ḍā hūm̐ las babs/ lī yang bstan/ de'i sa lha mo/

bon yang bstan/ oṃ dang phaṭa kyi spel ba/ bzlas pa'i sngags dang hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs pa/ kha zas sbyangs ba'ang bstan no/ / rlung ya/ dang me ra/ yi bcu gnyis/ bdun sa ha/ pa'i de zla tshes su bya ste/ zla tshes kyang bdud rtsi byung bas suṃ las kyang babs pas chos mthun/ don/ / sa btus/ha btus rdo rje ma| 'i sa bon de/ suṃ nyid kyis bskul/ / bas suṃ ste zla tshes su bya/ thig le dang*/ 'i sgras u/ ni mnan pas hūm̐/ ni/ / chos kyi 'khor lo'i hūm̐ las byang chub kyi sems kyi char gyi rgyun zhes bya bar gsungs/ /gsum pa las rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// // rtsa ba'i rgyud du lha mo bco lnga sna tshogs su kha bskang*/ gtso mo phyag bzhi par kha bskang de nas bdag med sgrub pa ni/ / brtag pa gnyis pa'i le'u brgyad par/ ci gsungs pa de 'dir/ mdo ru bsdus nas bshad/ / sngon du bya ba yang kha bskang*/ bshad pa rtsa rgyud dang 'dra'o// nam hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje las ra ba dang gur der chos 'byung*/ mkha'i stong pa nyid kyi/ khams kyi dbus gnas par | | raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ / rten gyi 'khor lo brten pa lha'i| snga ོna du 'byung ba rim rtseg gi ci rigs par/ / bskyed pa de'i rjes la/ lha rnams de'i/ ji ltar mngon par byang chub pa lngas/ 'byung ba nyid/ / mdor bstan/ 1'dir brjod 2 rgyas bshad 3bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo sa dang chu ni sngon/ /go rim bzhin du byin za dang*/ /lha lha rnams zhes spyir gsungs kyang 'dir spyan la sogs pa'i rim pas 'byung ba'i rim par bzhag rnams kyi ni rlung chen dang*/ /ji ltar bar do'i sems yig 'bru gsum ho gnyis kyi bar du chud pa/ sgom pa po 'byung ba'i/ /chos 'byung gi nang du bsgom/ las skyes 'khor lo ni/ /'phar ma gnyis dag yon po ma yin pa/ skyon med pa/ / zhig ral med pa/ lte ba la rdo rje ra bas bskor ba ze 'bru las ni gcig yin phyi rol rdo rje ra bas bskor ba gnyis

te/ / gru bzhi pa phyi rol chos 'byung gru gsum| rdo rje can gyi lte ba la mkha' spyod/ sa spyod/ nai rāta gsum rtseg sku gsum mchog / der paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma la bco lnga'i gdan dang ldan pa yi/ /ro ni nges par bsam par bya/ / mdor bstan de yi steng du zla ba yin/ /zla ba'i steng du sa bon ā li bco lnga| nyid/ /phyi nas kā li las/ bdud las rgyal bas mnan/ /gnyis 'dus pa las bde chen po/ 'i rgyu yin/ nir de sha ā li zla ba'i gzugs kyis gnas/ /kā li'i gzugs kyis snang byed do/ /zla ba nyi ma gnyis 'dus pa/ / 'dres pa nyid/ phyag mtshan gri gug bco lnga dkar mo la sogs rab tu grags/ / rab tu rgyas par bshad/ zla ba me long ye shes ldan/ /de bzhin mnyam nyid ye shes nyid/ /rang lha'i sa bon phyag mtshan ni | | so so ba'i de bzhin nyid so sor rtog par brjod par bya/ /thams cad gcig gyur bya nan tan/ /gzugs brnyan rdzogs pa dag pa'o/ / mngon byang lngas lhar bskyed pa la| mkhas pas cho ga gsungs pa ni/ /rnam pa lnga po bsgom par bya/ / mi mnyam par sbyor ba'i mngon byang lnga yin gsung*/ bdag med ma'i skabs su ā li las zla ba/ kā li las nyi ma ste mi mnyam sbyor la rgyu rdor 'dzin gyi skabs su gnyis ka las zla bar bskyed par mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /yang bdag med ma'i skabs su zlum po yin la/ 'dir gru gsum mo/ /de'i dgos pa mtshon bya tha dad do/ / ā gal te de ltar na bdag med mar bskyed na/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ni dbugs 'byung rngub las bskyed na/ phyag bcu drug pa'i skabs su rdo rje sems dpar gyur nas yang zhes 'byung ba de ji ltar bskyed snyam na/ li kā li mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi gdan/ / bdag med ma'i skabs su zla nyi'i bar du aṃ las byung ba'i gri gug la aṃ dgod pa/ 'dir ni zla ba'i bar du hūm̐ las rdo rje tsam dgod kyi| lte ba la hūm̐ mi dgod/

de nang gi don la dgongs so/ / yi ge las byung gong bu la/ /hūm̐ phaṭa rnam pa 'dod mi bya/ /sems dpa'i gzugs brnyan rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ las byung ba/ / dkyil 'khor bdag po bsgom par bya/ /phyag mtshan zhal zhabs gong ma gsum pa'i dang por bstan pa/ bzhin/ / khyad par ni 'di yin te/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang nag po yin la 'di ni zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od/ / nyi ma thabs dang zla ba/ shes rab rang bzhin las/ / de ltar thams cad rdzogs pa nyid/ /ā li las zla ba/ shes rab kā li las nyi ma| thabs/ /zla ba nyi ma'i rab dbye bas/ / so so'i mtshan nyid bstan gang phyir dkar mo la sogs pa/ / rdo rje ma la sogs pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin 'di las 'khor gyi lha mo kha dog so so ste/ sna tshogs so/ /yang na 'di las zhes bya ba ni gong gi bdag med ma'i 'khor gyi lha mo 'di las te/ de ni thams cad nag mo yin la 'di ni sna tshogs so/ /yang na war+ṇa te yi ge la zer bas bdag med ma'i sa bon aṃ| 'di las dkar mo la sogs pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge so so yin no/ kha dog dbye bas so so yin | | de phyir kun tu rab 'bad pas/ / gtso mo bskyed par ma zad dkyil 'khor pa yang lnga las bskyed par/ rab tu brtag /rnal 'byor ma lnga 'di dag ni/ /nang gi 'phar mar yang dag gnas/ /phung po lnga rnam par dag pa/ yi rang bzhin gyis/ /rnal 'byor rigs pas rtag tu bsgom/ /dbang por rdo rje ma/ gshin lho/ rjer dkar/ / mo| chu bdag chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /lus ngan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /dbus su bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /phyi rol 'phar mar dkar mo dang*/ /chom rkun de bzhin ro langs ma/ /ghasma rī dang puk+ka sī/ /ri khrod ma dang gdol pa mo/ / brgyad pa g.yung mos gang ba'o/ /'og ldan ma dang steng ldan nyid/ /mkha' spyod sa spyod ma zhes brjod/ /srid dang zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ / steng dang 'og gi ngos rtsa ba'i rgyud du ma tshang ba kha bskang gi tshul du bstan/

su bsgyur ma yang dag gnas/ / thams cad kyi kha dog nag mo/ yang 'dir sna tshogs par bstan pa ni mtshon byed nang la dgongs pa ste/ byang chub kyi sems de lus thams cad kyi dwangs ma yin pas sna tshogs su yong gsung skad lha mo thams cad sna tshogs mdog /drag chen phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ / gtso mo zhal gcig ma la phyag bzhi ma/ /spyan gsum 'od/ gsal ba'i gzugs can ma/ /'khor lo rna cha mgul rgyan dang*/ /lag par gdu bu ska rags ni/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni rnam dag pas/ / 'di lnga phyag rgya dag par gsungs/ /ji ltar bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ / phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa de bzhin du de ltar thams cad blta bar bshad/ / gtso mo phyag bzhi ma g.yon pas rnal 'byor ma'i/ lhung bzed dang*/ /de bzhin steng du gnyis par/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga / g.yas dang po/ na rdo rje sngon po dang*/ /de bzhin du yang gri gug nyid/ /ro la zhon zhing gzi brjid 'bar/ /spyan dmar de bzhin steng skyes ser/ kha dog sngon mo ches 'od*/ gsal ba/ /stag gi lpags pas snam dkris shing*/ /'jigs pa'i dus kyi me ni lta bur ni/ /gsal ba'i gzugs can ma de gnas/ /g.yas kyi kha dog na lho nas ser dang sngo ba'i mdog byang du dmar dang sngo ba'i mdog byang gi gnyis po rang ngos su/byang shar dang byang nub kyi'ang shugs kyis phye ba ltar/ nub dang gtso mo nag mo don gyis bstan gsung*/ dkar dang sngo ma ste/ / lho phyogs pa gnyis po dang dngos su lho shar dang lho nub kyi yang ser dang sngo bar 'ong*/ g.yon na ma rgad sngo dang mtshungs/ / 'khor phyag gnyis ma la zhal gcig ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /lag pa gcig na thod pas brel/ /g.yas na gri gug 'dzin pa ma/ /rgod dang khro zhing sgeg pa dang*/ /de ni g.yon gyi thod pa rnams kyi| mchod pa'i gzugs gnas pas/ /sangs rgyas sprin dang mnyam pa yi/ /'od zer sna tshogs kun tu spro/ / mkha' spyod/ sa spyod/ bdag med ma gsum sku gsung gyi ngo bo

de nyid yang na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs/ gsum gyi rang bzhin bdag / mkhas pas lte ba la/ dbus su bsgom par bya/ / spros pa la dga' na ye shes pa dgug gzhugadabang bskur ba kun kyang bya gsung*/ gsum pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// // 'khrugs can 'khrugs med gnyis las 'khrugs med gtso de nas dkyil 'khor chen po rigs lnga char dkyil 'khor gcig na gnas pas mchog / rdo rje dbyings/ yang dag rab tu bshad par bya/ / 1dkyil 'khor de'i ming 2rjes 'jug gi bri bsgom gnyis kyang rdo grangs kyang sum cu rtsa bdun du mnyam pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbyibs kyang gru bzhi pa la sogs par mnyam pas/ rje dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbyibs/ / ri'i rtse mo na rdo rje dbyibs zhes bya bar gsungs | | 1bri ba'i 2rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bstan 3 bsnyen pa rdzogs pa des dkyil 'khor gyi/ gnas ni sa/ sbyangs nas ni/ / brtag pa bdun pa dngos ltar sa yongs su bzung phyag rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon rtogs ston/ phyag gnyis pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas te yongs su gzung*/ / pa la sogs pa bya'o/ / thams cad rnam par bgegs bskrad pa'i phyir phyogs bcur/ bltas nas ni/ / snga gas pas gzhal yas khang*/ 'di ni bsgrub pa sa chog bdun pa'i gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa'i sbyin sreg dang*/ rab gnas le'u brgyad par bstan/ ra bya/ / rgyud phyi ma las 'dir sta gon 'ong*/ dkyil 'khor gzhan du longs ma spyad pa gsar pa legs par bkal ba 'jur mdud med pa/ dang*/ / ring thung nyis 'gyur shin tu tshad ma mdzes pa kha sgyur ba/ sa ni// srad bus thig gdab shes rab can/ / tshon dang 'brel bas zer yang thig tshon thun mong ngo ji ltar nus pa dang sbyar ba/ sa dkyil 'khor nyid/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs rnams kyis shin tu mdzes/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ / gnas sbyangs ba gos dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/

/mtshams kyi cha rnams thams cad dang*/ / sgo yi khyud kyi grwa rnams su/ / zla phyed rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras/ /phyi rol gyi/ dkyil 'khor gyi/ thig gdab par/ bya/ / 'phar ma gsum po/ de yi 'khor lo so so'i skabs/ / rigs lnga'i bzhugs gnas/ nang du yang ni zhugs nas ni/ /rdo rje nang gi thig ni yongs ye shes thig dang gsung*/ bcug cing*/ / 'phar ma dang po/ phyi rol dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ / tshon gyi cho ga ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ /rdo rje ka ba'i nang logs su| rtser mdun du/ gnas la/ / zla ba'i/ dkyil 'khor lnga rigs lnga/ yis rnam par brgyan// de nas zla ba'i/ dkyil 'khor lnga'i/ nang du ni/ / rigs lnga'i sangs de nas mchod pa bshams pa dang bum pa dbul pa la sogs pa bya'o// rgyas kyi/ gzugs brnyan lnga/ sku tsaka li'am/ thugs phyag mtshan| rnam par dgod/ / gong du gsungs satwa saṃ gra ha las/ pa'i tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bri ba'i| dkyil 'khor cho ga yi/ / dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la rkang pa gnyis kyis bshad par dam bca'| |dkyil 'khor sgrub pa khyod la bshad par bya/ / yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrubs nas mchod pa bya'o/ /slob dpon bdag 'jug cho ga yang bya'o/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi yan lag dang mchod pa dang sdom pa bzung ba thams cad bstan no/ de la dang por yud tsam gyi rdo rje sems dpa'/ lha nyid kyi/ / 1dkyil 'khor gyi khyim 'dis bsgrub pa dngos su bstan te bsnyen pa/ sa chogasta gon gsum ka'i rnal 'byor dang*/ mchog gi dngos grub kyi rnal 'byor kyang bstan gsung*/ du sngags pa zhugs nas ni/ / snying khar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /bsams nas de 'i steng du hūm̐ las/ steng rdo rje ni/ /dkar po rtse mo lnga pa nyid/ / hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i cho de la rdo rje sems dpar bskyed la de'i snying kha'i hūm̐ gis 'od spros te rang bzhin gyi gnas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/

yang snying kha las lha mo brgyad spros te mchod pa/ gas bsam par byas nas ni | | de bzhin gshegs pa kun sogs byang sems dang bla ma/ la/ /mchod nas phyag 'tshal 'di skad gsol/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag la thugs| dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ni che ge mo gsang mtshan nas/ zhes bgyi | | dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges pa thob par/ mdzad pa'i/ / rgyu| byang chub smon pa'i/ sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis smon pa/ bskyed par bgyi | | 'jug pa dge ba'i chos ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsdu ba bzhi/ dang*/ / byang chub sems dpa' bcu gcig sems can don byed tshul khrims dang*/ / sdom pa'i tshul khrims bslab pa rnam pa gsum/ /so sor bdag gis brtan por

byang chub la mthar thug gi bar du srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ba'o/ / gzung*/ / rnam par snang mdzad kyi gsung sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ / bai ro sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ / dkon mchog gsum mchod pa'i tshul gyi sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya 'i dam tshig gsum| yang*/ /de nyid las ni mi 'bral ba'i tshul gyis/ so sor bzung*/ /slob dpon dag kyang bsnyen bkur ba'i tshul gyis/ bzung bar bgyi/ / tshim par bya ba'i tshul gyis rin chen rigs mchog rnal 'byor gyi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyi ma re re zhing dus drug drug byas nas/ / pha rol tu phyin pa/ sbyin pa rnam bzhi sems can mi spang zhing tshim pa'i tshul gyis/ rtag tu sbyin/ / so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi byang chub chen po las byung ba/ / pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang mi smod cing rang gi lus la ldan pa'i tshul gyis/ so sor bzung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad mi nyams pa'i tshul gyis/ ldan par ni/ /thams cad so sor bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i tshul gyis/ las kyang ci nus bgyi/ / de rnams rang gi rigs kyi gtso bo yin la gzhan yang yan lag gi tshul gyi byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ / rigs drug gi dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus bzung bar bgyi/ / chu bo bzhi las ma rgal ba dag rgal bar bgyi/ /mdud pa ma grol ba dag dgrol bar bgyi/ / skye ba la sogs pa las dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i/ mya ngan 'das la dgod/ / tshad med yod med 'dra/ bzhi bsgom pa yang don gyis rtogs par byas la ye shes kyi tshogs stong nyid bsgom pa de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa

sa chos/ thams cad kyi rtse mo 'am mchog la/ las byung ba stong pa nyid/ zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te stong nyid ston pa'i/ tshig 'di dag bka' stsal ba/ de nas bsam gtan gnas dkyil 'khor gyi khang par/ 'dug nas/ /chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin| bdag med par/ / sems yang dag rjes su blta bar bya/ / tshul ji ltar ston zhe na phyi snod/ dang nang bcud/ gi bdag nyid can/ /'di dag thams cad sems las logs pa med par/ su brtags/ /sems las ma gtogs pa nyid ni/ /gzhan na yod pa ma yin no/ / sems kun tu rtog pa dang btags pa'i dri ma dang bral chos kun sems yin la de'i/ rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /chos kun dang por nas ma skyes mthar 'gag pa gnas pa med| ma skyes phyir/ / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yid kyi a rang bzhin de skye med rnam dag brjod| nud sarba dharmā pra kri ti pra bha wa sarba dharmā/ pan+na 'di ni dang la stong pa nyid du de nas sngags kyis bstan nas brjod/ / 1der 'og gi gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i don 'dir sbyar 2 stong pa nyid kyi ngang las raṃ las nyi ma/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs sogs rdo rje gsor la zhal bzhi'i sngags/ gzhan yang khang bskyed pa de bdag mngon par byang chub pa lngas rnam par snang mdzad chen po bskyed pa bstan/ nas de nyid rang sems skye ba med pa 'og nas kyi sngags de nyid kun tu btags pa dang kun rtog gi dri ma dang bral bar bsgom/ 'dis/ / a bhi dang po gnyis la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ rnam pa/ de'i ngo bo/ ngag tu ci brjod lnga la| gsum la rnam/ ngo bo/ ngag tu gsung*/ rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal bas/ / sems kun rtog gi dri ma da nga bral ba 'dod pa'i don mtshon par byed pa'i/ snga gas kyi bzlas pas ni/ / gru gsum zla sems nyid rnam pa zla ba/ ngo bo rtog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba/ ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par blta | | sems so sor rtog par bgyi'o zhes btags pa dang rtog pa'i dri ma gnyis dang bral ba'o/

/ oṃ tsit+ta pra ti bai dhaṃ ka ro mi zhes/ sems de nyid sgrib pa gnyis kyi tshogs dang bral tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ches dag pa/ /nam mkha' lta bur btags pa dang rtog pa'i/ dri ma med/ / the tshom yid gnyis gzung 'dzin/ kun las rnam par shes bya'i sgrib pa las/ grol/ / mchog tu rnam sngon byung dang po'i dus skad cig dang po bar chad med pa'i lam/ gnyis pa nas rnam grol brnyes nas sangs rgyas te rjes 'jug mngon rtogs mngon byang lnga kas bskyed pa ston/ par rtog pa 'joms | | nyon mongs dri ma thams cad dag /dang por sems rtag cha dran ja pa dang rtog pa gnyis dang bral ba de rnam pa/ zla ba ltar bltas nas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes de la mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa mtshon pa'i ā li phrag gnyis/ yang na ye shes de nyid la kun tu rtog pa bcu drug gis stong pa'i yon tan yod pas ā li gcig tu dgod/ kun gyi yon tan 'dir/ / rnam pa a sogs gzugs kyis zla ba de la/ 'jug par 'gyur/ /a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥbacom ldan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /yon tan dang*/ khyad par gyi chos/ ji ltar lags/ / zhus/ lan bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / rnam thar gsum gru gsum khyad par bstan/ rgya chen rang bzhin rnam pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ngo bo me long gsung*/ can/ / sems zla ba lta bu de la sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan rtog pa bcu drug gis stong pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis gnas/ / yon tan 'di ni rnam pa/ a sogs gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas yon tan 'jug par 'gyur/ / bas ā li dgod/1ā li denyid kyang 2kha dog shel dang zla ba lta bur ni/ / zla ba de yi steng du 'jug par 'gyur | | 'di'ang don lnga sems ni rang bzhin gyis rtag cha dran ja rtog gnyis dang bral bas so sor rtog pa/ 'od gsal ba/ /de nyid/ yi dga' bar bskyed pa'am mngon du/ byed pa'i rgyu/ / rjes 'jug sgrub pa po

snga gas pas 'di yi sngags kyis ni/ /byang chub sems ni mngon du| bskyed par bya/ / me long lta bu la mnyam nyid/ ngag tu oṃ byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bgyi/ bo dhi tsit+ta ud pa ta yā mi/ / sems rtogs pa byas pa'i rjes su sems bskyed pa'i/ rim byung ba | | sems can sems bskyed pas sems 'di lta bu ma skyes pa snying rje snyam stai sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ / rjes su 'dzin pa po/ /dge ba'i chos kyi dpe byad brgyad cus/ che ba'i yon tan yang dag gang*/ / mnyam nyid/ spang bya phyis mi skye bar nyon mongs thams cad nges par gnon | | ā li las cha 1 jacha 4 ja byang chub zla ba gnyis pa can/ / kā li las cha 3 ja zla cha 2 ja ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ / cha 5 ja 'dir yang skar ma'i rnam pas nam mkha' la skar ma rgyas pa bzhin/ ni/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad brgyad cu la/ yang na mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis| yon tan rnam pa/ ka sogs kyi/ /gzugs kyis gzugs brnyan lta bu yi/ / rnal 'byor gyis ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha bsnan pas bzhi bcur 'gro/ rjes 'jug gi mngon rtogs dang sbyar ba 'di yi dkyil 'khor cho ga mngon byang gnyis pa/ kun/ / bya ba'i rgyud la sogs pa rgyud ni gzhan du gang du'ang*/ khyad par du saṃ gra ha dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro gnyis su/ ma gsungs so/ / zla ba nyis rtseg gi steng ma de yi ge las byung gong bu'i don/ la dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje/ rtse lnga pa/ /'od zer dkar po bcas pa nyid// sems rtog pa kun tu bzang po'i sems de nyid/ bskyed pa/ / de brtan so sor rtog pa'i ngo bos| par byed pa'i rgyu yi phyir/ /bdag nyid rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan du/ / rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'di yi sngags kyis bsgom par bya/ / ngag tu oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ bdag la rdo rje mnos shig byang chub sems bskyed pa/

spyod pa shin tu rnam par dag pas sems can gyi don byed pa/ bla na med | | de yi sa ni sa bon las bskyed pa/ rtogs pa 'di/ / kun rtog gi ye shes dag pa zag pa med/ / de brtan par byed pa zla rnam pa/ ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ / phyag mtshan rdo rje las mngon par byang chub pa rdo rdo rje de las/ rje nges par brtag par bya/ / 'di na mar gnyis su bya ste rnam par sogs/ bya ba nan tan gyi bdag nyid du byang chub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid byang chub kyi sems chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid du dbyer med pa las mngon par byang chub pa nam mkha'i khams ni thams cad kyi/ /tshad rdo rje phra mo dpag tu med pa spros te de dag las de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dpag tu med pas sems can la khyab par byas nas slar 'dus te rdo rje la thim pa'o/ / du yang dag gang bar ni/ /rdo rje lus kyi bdag nyid du/ / snga gas pas bsgom par bya ba'o/ /'dis ni sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ / rdo rje phra mo mang po spro ba dang ni tshur rdo rje la/ bsdu bar bya/ / ngag tu oṃ badz+rāt+ma ko3 haṃ/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin nga'am bdag go| sangs rgyas rang gi ngo bo bya ba nan tan chos kyi sku/ kun gyi sku gang ni/ / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de bzhin nyid/ dngos po 'am mtshan mar snang ba med cing gnas med pa/ / sngar rgyu las ma skyes ma byas mtshan rtog dag pa nyid/ / yod med gnyis kyi dngos po med pa la sogs pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bas/ spangs/ / te rig pa gsal la ma 'gags/ mtshon sogs kyis gcad kal/ med dbyer med gzung 'dzin sems kyis/ gzung du med/ / de nyid/ chos kyi sku ni gzugs med pa/ / de lta bu dang tha mi dad par rdo rje'i bdag nyid yang dag gyur/ / sku gsung thugs ro gcig du gyur pa rdo rje'i sku ni gong na med/ /de dharmā dha tu'i bo dha byang*/ ltar chos kyi sku dbyer med par ma zad de/

de bzhin gshegs pa dang gzugs skur yang dbyer med par bstan/ yang rdo rje la/ sa phyag mtshan pa chos kyi bsgom par bya ba bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyon cig rdo rje 'chang chen po/ lnga pa yang ni gzugs sku las chos rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ / mtshan dpe la sogs pa rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams chos sku/ kyi gzugs brnyan ni/ /'di yi sngags kyis bsgom par bya/ / ngag tu oṃ ya ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs sku phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa de ltar bdag kyang de dang dbyer med/ tha sarba ta thā ga ta thā haṃ/ ji lta'i bdag kyang de lta'o/ me long lta bu 'dir 'ong gsung*| sku dang gsang ba de 'di la rang ngo bo ma bshad/ bzhin spyod/ / de dag gi don bsdus pa/ mnyam pa nyid/ bya ba nan tan/ chos kyi dbyings spyod yul gsum pa/ de nyid rtogs so sor rtog pa ni | | rjes 'jug gi mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga/ /sangs rgyas kyi rgyu lnga/ kun gyi bdag nyid dge / yod med 'dra dang po rnal 'byor ro/ de dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog nas mkha' gsang gi don/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pas 'i 'khor thams cad/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ / 'khor gyi lha rnams dbyung bar bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan gsang ba'i rdo rje dang*/ / gsang ba'i pad+ma'i de gnyis kyi bdag po'i| rigs kyi ming ci lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / gsang ba'i rdo rje ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'/ la gnas/ / pas byin gyis rlabs gsung*/ pad+ma'i rigs ni lha mo chen la mo thams cad/ ra ldan/ pas byin gyis rlabs/ de yi rdo rje pad+ma'i steng du gnas/ / pa de snyoms par zhugs pa/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgra de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs te bdag gi sna bug g.yas nas nang du zhugs pa de yum gyi mes zhu ste rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste pad+mar babs pa las lha sum cu rtsa bdun bskyed de pad+ma nas bton nas so so'i gnas su dgod pa'o/

/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngal skyes kyi tshul du gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa dbyung*/ cho ga yan lag gsum gyis ji lta ba bzhin bton nas 'og gi shar du ni rnam snang sogs sbyar bton/ / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go /de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs| ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab/ kha bskang*/ de nas de ltar bdag nyid rnam par snod bcud/ srung 'khor/ dur khrod/ gzhal yas khang*/ lha rnams bdag tu sdud zer/ snang mdzad du chen por/ mi bskyod par byas nas/ / rdo rje 'chang*/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa/ 'byung ba bzhi'i sa bon gyi steng 'og tu hūm̐ bzhi pas srung ba'i 'khor lo bya/ steng rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa ston/ dang 'og tu sngags kyi yi ge hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐ zhes pa la sogs pa/ bkod de so so'i sngags las/ cho ga bzhin du hūm̐ suṃ hūm̐/ ri rab dang chos 'byung*/ gru gsum rgya chen po'i ngo bo can bskyed par bya ste/ 'od zer sna tshogs pa dang ldan/ pa'i 'byung bzhi'i| dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa las der bh+rūṃ las/ yang dag par byung ba'i mdzes pa'i gnas bsgoms nas/ ri rab der paṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+mar raṃ las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / mdor/ rgyas rlung yaṃ las rlung yaṃ gis mtshan pa/ raṃ las me raṃ gis mtshan pa/ waṃ las chu waṃ gis mtshan pa/ laṃ las sa laṃ gis mtshan pa/ dang me'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa/ dang ldan pa ya ra la was brgyan pa'o/ /de nas de'i steng bh+ruṃ las/ du ri rab bskyed| snga gas las gzhal yas khang bskyed/ kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi yon tan du ma'i sgo nas/ gsol ba btab cing bstod la/ de nyid kyi rab tu bsngags pa a las/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi/ rab tu gsal ba dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa kha dog sna tshogs shing dril bu dpyangs pa dang*/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i gos dang 'phan dang*/

me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ do shal dang*/ sgo khyud la do shal phyed pa zla bas nye bar mdzes par chag gas la sogs pa med pa/ 'da' yab karma shir sha'i ste rdo rje nor bu/ rin po che las grub pa'i ri rab kyi/ rtse mor gzhal med khang bsam par bya'o/ / mkha' gsang byin rlabs kha bskang hūm̐ gi dam tshig sems dpa' ni gong du 'byin pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa yin la pad+ma nas gtso bo bton te de dbus kyi lte bar bzhag pa de'i snying khar mngon par byang chub gas med kyang rung*/ pa lngas ye shes sems dpa' bskyed par bstan/ sum cu rtsa drug po gzhan la 'gre'o/ /de dag gi snying khang rdo rje nas

rang gi phyag mtshan/ 'bras tsam ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ste sum rtsegs snga gas dbang gnas su thig le so bdun/ de snying khar drangs pas de las sa bon/ de las lhar byas pa'am/ yang na a bha yas sa bon nyid spro/ gzhung na de gsal/ 'dis dbang gi gnas su thig ge rang gi snying khar dang po'i gnyis pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du hūm̐/ snga gas dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ 'di bkod de nyid/ gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ bsgom par bya'o/ / de las 'od 'phros te khyab par byas nas slar yang rdo rje la thim/ rdo rje phra mo'i 'od zer las yang sangs rgyas thams cad spro ba dang bsdu ba bya zhing*/ rdo rje de nyid yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa zla ba'i kha dog gi 'od lta bu ste zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhugs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dpa' bo shes rab rdo rje snyems ma/ dang dga' ba gcig pus mdzes pa/ dang po gnyis rdo rje dang*/ dril bu dang*/ bar pa gnyis ral gri dang*/ lcags kyu nyid dang*/ tha ma gnyis thod pa dang*/ zhags pa 'dzin pa nyid do/ /g.yas pa ni kha dog nag po'o/ /g.yon pa ni pad+ma rā ga'i 'od do/ /zhal gsum pa dbus dkar ba/ dang*/ bzhi pa rdo rje ral gri dril bu thod pa bsnams pa yod/ phyag drug pa nyid dang*/ spyan gsum pa dang*/ bzang po'i 'dug stangs/ gzugs can te rang gi rig ma'i pad+ma la snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshul gyis/ bzhugs pa dang*/ zag pa med pa'i dges pa'i dkyil 'khor ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ bsgom par sum rtseg bya'o/ / sems dpa' sum rtseg de ltar bsgoms nas rang gi snying kha'i ye shes sems dpa'i zla ba la sngags bkod la bzlas pa bya'o/ /'jog par 'dod na dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yum dang bcas pa snying kha'i hūm̐ la bsdus te yab 'ba' zhig gis spyod lam bya'o/

/sngags he badz+ra dang 'dra'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bri ba la dang po sa chog dkyil 'khor gnas ni sbyangs zhes bya ba la sogs pa sbyar ro/ /thun mtshams su sems dpa' sum rtseg tu bzhugs pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya'o/ /'khor gzhan rnams rnam pa thams cad kyi phyag mtshan brtag pa gnyis pa dngos su/ mchog mtshan dpe/ dang ldan par dkyil 'khor pa rigs bzhi la sogs pa/ 'ang ye shes sems dpa' bskyed pa de rab tu 'di'i sngags brtag pa brgyad pa dngos nas/ sa bon bdun pa'i gsum pa nas/ brtag par spros pa la dga' na yan lag bzhi gsung na| bya'o/ / thod pa zla ba la kun shar du ni cho ga gsum gyi/ rnam par snang mdzad bh+rūṃ las/ do/ / lhor ni aṃ/ rin chen 'byung ser po/ gnas phyag bzhi rin po lcags kyu thod zhags/ so/ /nub tu hrīḥ ni 'od dpag med dmar po/ pa'o/ / dang po gnyis mda' gzhu pad zhags/ thod zla byang du ni khaṃ/ gdon mi za bar grub pa'o/ / ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ dril bu/ thod pa/ thod pa dang zla ba la dbang ldan du ni bh+ruṃ/ spyan ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma g.yas bzhi na 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ ral gri mda'/ g.yon na thod pa/ dril bu/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ no/ /mer ni hūm̐ mā ma ki sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bcu gnyis ma/ g.yas pa drug na mda'/ ral gri rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ g.yon na gzhu/ lcags kyu/ dril bu/ zhags pa/ thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'o/ /bden bral du ni hrīḥ gos dkar mo dmar mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma g.yas pa bzhi na mda'/ pad+ma/ ral gri rdo rje| g.yon gzhu/ thod pa/ zhags pa/ dril bu/ 'o/ /rlung du ni tāṃ las/ sgrol ma ljang khu zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma g.yas ut+pal dmar/ ral gri lcags kyu mda'/ g.yon 'khor lo/ zhags pa/ thod pa/ gzhu 'o | | phyi rol gyi 'phar ma la aṃ/ drag shul ma ni phyag mtshan gnyis pa nas/ kha dog dkar mo zhal cig phyag bzhi ma cha mda' ja lcags kyu/ gzhu/

thod pa/ 'o/ /lhor rdo rje gzugs brnyan ma āṃ/ ni kha dog ser mo'o/ / phyag bzhi na rdo rje/ mdung*/ zhags pa/ thod pa/ nub tu ni iṃ| 'dod chags rdo rje ma kha dog dmar mo phyag bzhi na ral gri dang*/ rdo rje/ zhag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dril bu/ 'o/ /byang du ni rdo rje zhi ba īṃ/ ma kha dog ljang khu'o/ / phyag bzhi na ba dan| rdo rje/ ral gri thod pa/ dbang ldan du uṃ/ ni rdo rje gnod sbyin ma dkar ser lta bu phyag bzhi na/ rdo rje/ ut+pal/ thod pa/ cang te'u/ 'o/ /me ru ni ūm̐ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser lta bu'o/ / pad+ma/ me long*/ chang gis bkang ba'i thod pa/ dgra s+t+wa/ bden bral du aṃ/ ni sgra'i rdo rje ma sngon dmar lta bu 'o/ / mdung*/ dung*/'khor lo/ khrag gi gang ba'i thod pa/ rlung du ni aḥ sa'i rdo rje ma ni ljang skya ma lta bu 'o/ / bum pa/ rdo rje/ thod pa rdzas kyi bkang ba dang*/ mi'i lpags pas bkab pa dang*/ dril bu/ phyi rol gyi 'phar rim pa gnyis pa'i/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gsum pa na ma ning bzhi las lā s+ye sogs phyogs bzhi na yod/ ma la dbang ldan du ni drag gdan gyi skabs su me nas/ gla ིnga 'di byang sems brgyad dang*/ bu ma oṃ dkar/ 'o/ /me ru oṃ/ ni pi wang ma ser| 'o/ /bden bral du ni mu eṃ/ kun dmar/ da'o/ /rlung du ni rdza aiṃ/ rnga ljang*/ ma'o/ / gling bu ma la sogs pa ni phyag gnyis ma la zhal gcig ma phyogs bzhir sems dpa' brgyad phyogs rer gnyis gnyis dgod 'o/ / 'phar ma bzhi pa'i phyi rol gyi snam bu 'i mtshams bzhir me nas brtsams nas/ la me tog ma la sogs pa'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor ma de ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄/ bzhag par bya ste de bzhin du phyag gnyis ma'o/ / gsum pa'i dang po dang 'dra/ shar gyi sgor lha mo rdo rje lcags kyu ma dzaḥ nam mkha'i dbus/ sngobasangs lta bu zhal g.yas pa dang gzhan pa ni g.yas/ gnag pa dang g.yon/ dkar ba'o/ / phyag g.yas pa'i dang po na ni lcags kyu'o/

/gnyis pa ni ral gri 'phyar ba'o/ / gsum pa na ni 'khor lo'o/ /g.yon pa na zhags pa dang*/ sdigs mdzub dang*/ dril bu 'dzin pa ste phyag drug pa bri bar bya'o/ /lho'i sgor hūm̐/ ma mo rdo rje zhags pa ma dbus/ dkar ser lta bu ste zhal g.yas dang gzhan pa ni nag pa dang dmar ba'o | | g.yas pa ni zhags pa dang*/ /rdo rje dang ral gri 'phyar ba'o/ / g.yon na 'khor lo dang*/ dril bu dang*/ sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa can te phyag drug go / nub kyi sgo la ni baṃ/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma de bzhin du gzhan yang kha dog dmar zhing gzi brjid che ba zhal g.yas pa dang gzhan pa ni nag pa dang dkar ba dbus dmar ba 'o/ /phyag drug na lcags sgrog dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ ral gri dang*/ 'khor lo dang | dril bu dang*/ lcags kyu'o/ /byang gi sgo la ni ho/ rdorje dril bu ma 'jigs par byed ma ste zhal gsum ni ljang khu dang*/ nag mo dang*/ dkar mo'o/ /phyag drug na ni dril bu dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ ral gri dang | zhags pa'o/ /thams cad skra steng du 'bar ba ste sna tshogs pad+mar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du bzhag par bya'o/ /me'i phyogs nas brtsams te gong gi me tog ma zhes pa'i mjug bsdu ba'i tshul/ me tog la sogs pa'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor ma de bzhag par bya ste/ phyag gnyis mar gsungs so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su ni rnal 'byor ma lcags kyu ma dang*/ zhags pa ma dang*/ lcags sgrog ma dang | dril bu'i lag pa ma ste sgo skyong ma dang yang dag par ldan pa'o/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes bya ba 'di rnams kyi snying po bstan pa ste rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya ba la/ the tshom mi za'o/ / lugs ma dang brdung ma la sogs pa gzugs de 'byung ba'i tshul gyis/ ltar bkod pa dang*/ dngos su byas pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis kyang mtshan ma dang phyag rgya dang ldan pa'i dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i

rdul tshon gyi/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / 1mnyam sbyor rtog pa lnga par dbugs dbyung du drag bcas dbang bcas zhes sogs gsungs kyang dkyil 'khor dang sa bon dur khrod kha bskang*/ he ru ka yang gdan dang dur khrod kha bskang 2drag po gdan can 3rdo rje dbyings 'phar ma bzhi pa las 'dir gnyis pa gong ma lta bu de'i 'phar ma gnyis/ phyed kyi nang gi 'phar ma la thig bzhi btab pas le tshe dgu yod pa'i le tshe dbus ma la de'i nang du zla ba phyed pa'i dbyibs lta bu'i aṃ las nang gi dkyil 'khor/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang 'dra ba zer/ de'i steng du he ru ka dang*/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa nas srung 'khor gi bar 'dra| bh+rūṃ las khang pa na/ spyir gzhal yas khang de ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa dang*/ le tshe dbus ma'i phyi rol du haṃ thung*/ ri mo rdo rje ra ba la ri mo gnyis me 'od la ri mo gnyis te/ bzhis drwa ba phyed pa ste de la yi ge bzhi yod pas so/ / yongs su bskor ba'o/ / dbus na drag po'i gdan can lha mo thams cad kyi gnas nang gi le mtshan brgyad/ su ji skad gsungs pa'i zla ba phyed pa lta bu'i rlung*/ gdan rnams ni dkar mo la sogs pa rab tu brtag par bya'o/ / mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad de la dbus su ni hi'i yi ge'i las drag po'i gdan can gyi/ rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i shar gyi re mig la ni hrīḥ las gau rī/ 'o/ /lho ru ni ho las tsau rī/ 'o/ /nub tu ni gi las be tā lī/ 'o/ /byang du ni dzi las ghasma rī/ 'o/ /me ru ni haṃ las sha wa rī/ ngo*/ /bden bral du ni dzaṃ las tsaṇ+ḍā lī/ ngo*/ /rlung du ni maṃ las g.yung mo/ ngo*/ / dbang ldan du ni haṃ las puk+ka sī/ ngo*/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du dgod pa ni mtshams su am̐ gling bu ma/ ngo*/ /bden bral du ūm̐ pi wang ma/ ngo*/ /rlung du e mu kun da 'o || dbang ldan du ai rdza rnga ma/ dgod par bya'o/ / zhal bzhi phyag bzhi

shar gyi sgo la dzaḥ rta gdong ma/ 'o/ /lho ru hūm̐ phag gdong ma/ ngo*/ /nub tu baṃ seng gdong*/ mo/ /byang du ni hoḥ khyi gdong*/ dgod par bya'o/ /phyi rol tu dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams te/ der dbang po la sogs pa'i 'byung po chen po brgyad po 'jigs par byed pa dgod par bya'o/ / 'phrog pa shar du ha pa na shes shing yin/ ri pa sa shi ri sha zhes bya/ a ru ra'i zer te min/ la/ /lha yi tshogs phyogs skyong dbang po/ ni yang dag bri | | lho ru a mra zhes bya/ tsu ta'i shing la kham bu'i shing yin/ ni/ / phyogs skyong gshin rje'i gtso bo'i dbang phyug bri/ /nub tu a sho ka kaṃ kha la zhes kyang bya/ gnas a rdzu na/ su/ / sprin gy-i rgyal po chu bdag de nas dgod/ /de bzhin byang du byang chub a shwat+tha zhes kyang bya| shing*/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon lus ngan po/ mnyam par bzhag /de bzhin mer ni shing*| ka rañdzar/ / me lha drang srong tshogs kyis yang dag khyab/ /bden bral bha tra zhes bya/ la ta dza sdong po shin tu che ba/ tar shing 'khril shing can/ ni/ /srin po la sogs phyogs skyong*/ de nas dgod/ /rlung du pār+thi ba shing u dum wa ra gser shing*/ la a dzu na/ ni/ / phyogs skyong rlung gi bdag po yang dag bri/ /dbang ldan shing chen/ pa ṭa s+tha n+ya gro ta la ni/ / phyogs skyong yi dwags tshogs ni yang dag bri/ / de'i gdan drag po 'khor dang*/ bcas dbang bcas nye dbang bcas/ / drag po gdan can gyi nges tshig go/ zla ba dang*/ bcas nyi ma dang*/ gshin rje'i cha/ / 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ gdan du mnan rgyas btab de dag gi sems/ rmongs bcas de dag gi sha zos byas shing*/ /thal ba tsam du lus par byas/ ba'i dngos bcas 'tsho bar byed/ / slar thar pa la dgod/ thabs dang shes rab yum dang bcas pa/ rigs pas yang*/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni mchan khung*/ g.yon par ni/ / gang la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la 'phyang*/ ni gnas pa dang*/ /

g.yon gyi phyag na/ thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang*/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*/ / gdams kha khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i steng du/ gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams | | g.yas su rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par mdzad | | skyil krung phyed pa byas nas ni/ /nyid kyi yum gyi zhabs kyis/ brla steng g.yon pa mnan/ /tshangs pa la sogs mnan pa yang*/ / 'jig rten la/ grags pa'i phyis mi 'tsho ba'i/ nye bar mi sha de dag za ste/ / slar gso kun tu 'od zer lnga/ sna tshogs kyi// sangs rgyas sprin dang mnyam pa 'dis/ / spyan las spro ba yang thar pa la dgod/ ni sbyin par bya/ / mjug tu lha mo rnams rang gi snying khar bsdus la gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya'o/ / mjug bsdu de ltar rnal 'byor pas dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ bsgom na/ / phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /dpal yang dag par spyor ba las byung ba ste brtag pa'i rgyal po gsum pa'o// //༈ rim pa gnyis la gnas pa des spyod pa byed pa la grogs ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir brda la sogs pa bstan bcom ldan rnal 'byor pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i/ / brda' ngag rtogs pa bskyed pa mtshon par bya ba las mi 'da' ba/ gi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid de/ /gsang ba nyan par 'tshal lags na/ /thub pa chen pos bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro ma sa byin gyis rlabs zhing bar chad med pas/ rnam par rgyal ba'i stobs zhes bya ba'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dbang du gyur pa dang byin gyis rlob cing bar chad mi byed pas gsung*/ ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas mkha' 'gro ma'i ḍā ki ma rnams kyi rtog pa brda'i sgo nas mtshon pas/ mtshon par bya ba las mi 'da' bas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bka' stsal pa/ phyag rgya bsdus pa dang cha mthun/ thabs ko l+la i re kye zhes 'bod pa/tha ti cha s+thi ja ta gnas pa thabs te thabs la gnas pa'o/ /

rdo rje a bo lā mum+mu shes rab/ ṇi re kye zhes bod pa/ kak+ko lā/ chos kyi 'byung gnas/ gha ṇe tshogs/ kṛ pi ṭa cang te'u/ ho bādz+dza i/ brdung bar bya/ ka ru ṇe ki snying rjes bya/ a i nā mi bya/ ro lā/ rtsod pa/ ta hiṃ dus der/ ba la sha khādz+dza i/ bza' bar bya/ gā ḍeṃ ma a ṇā chang bidz+dza a i/ btung bar bya/ ha le kye grogs po kā liñdza dza ra sngal ba dang ldan pa/ pa ṇi a i/ cha 'ong du gzhug ja dun+du ra dam tshig dang mi ldan pa skal med/ bidz+dza a i/ 'ong du mi gzhug tsa u sa ma dri chen/ kā ts+tshu rī dri chu/ kā p+pu ra/ rak+ta/ si h+pha/ byang sems/ lā i a i/ lus la byug par bya/ mā la in+dha ṇa tshod ma su liñdza/ sha chen las byas pa'i/ da hiṃ dus der/ bha ru khā i a i/ cha mang po ja btung bar bya/

phreṃ kha na 'ong*/ kha ḍa 'gro ka ran+ti byed pa'i dus/ shud+dha dag pa a shud+dha ma dag pa na mu ṇi a i/ mi blta/ ni raṃ su aṃ ge tsa ḍā rus rgyan gdags/ wi/ ta tshogs la 'du dus/ hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa dpa' bo g.yul du gsad pa'i ro/ ṇi a i cha de blangs la dbul bar bya/ ja ma la a dze 'du ba/ kun du ru bā ḍa i/ snyom 'jug byed na/ ḍiṇ+ḍi ma ta hin+na badz+dzi a i/ reg min dang snyoms par 'jug par bya'o/ /gdan bzhi gzhan gyi gdan gyi rab tu byed pa dang po dang*/ mkha' 'gro le'u bzhi pa dang cha mthun mu sor mo khar bcug pa mkha' 'gro ma'i brda/ khi/ mar me ma'i gho ghu/ 'jib byed ma'i ghu gu/ mu g.yo ldan ma'| gu lu dge ba'i rnams dri mi'i/ gu draṣ+ta/ rnal 'byor ma'i/ ngag gi brda 'di rgyas par brtag pa bdun pa'i rab byed dang po nas 'chad/ rnams bltas nas bud med gang phrad pa rnams la brjod pa| rnal 'byor pas 'du ba'i brda'i/ don go bas chog go mtshan ma gsungs pa/ bdun par lus brda dang ngag brda sbyar ba bdun par yod pas 'dir med pa yin pas phyogs gcig tu shes par bya/ zhes bya ba la spro bar bya'o/ / rtsa nyi shu bzhi 'am/ byang sems nyi shu rtsa bzhi po dang rtogs par mi 'gyur bas yi ge bcu gnyis me la reg pas brda'o/ /1ḍa sogs la gur bco lnga/ abhi sum cu so brgyad/ ḍā ki brgyad par cha/ pu sogs der kha bskang*/ 'dus pa gu nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ a bhi bzhi par cha ste/ de dag kyang phan tshun 'brel bas phyogs gcig tu gsol lo/ /2na ra ḍa/ skyes pa/ na rī ḍi/ bud med/ bu/ rengs pa/ su/ zla ba/ mā/ ma ru/ yo/ chung ma/ bhi/ sring mo/ dpe tshan gcig la 'di bhi ru yod dhī/ mdza' mo/ lu/ bu mo/ s+t+rī/ khrag sa/ chang*/ tha mal pa'i btung ba kha cig tu thug par yod pe/ zhi ba'i btung ba/ phī/ sha bha/ bza' ba/ bhu/ 'du ba/ pī/ dur khrod/ bhu/ ro/ ḍi/ rnam 'byor ma phag mo/ ga lā ma/ tri/ rū pa can ma/ ku/ ḍā ki ni/

kha/ dum skyes/ dzā/ kun du ru/ kye lag pa gnyis| ke rkang pa'i byin pa zung*/ na mo bha/ swa/ legs par 'ong ba/ rtsa rgyud le'u bco lnga par kha bskang*| bdun par yang 'di ma bshad pu/ li ra ma la ya/ dzā/ lan dha ra/ o/ ḍi ya na/ a/ ra bu ta/ go ta wa ri/ ra/ mi shwa ra/ de/ wi ko ṭa/ ma/ la wa/ ka ma ru pa/ o/ ḍe/ tri/ sha ku ne/ ko sa la/ ka liṅka/ la/ ma pa ka kā ñtsi/ hi/ ma la ya/ pre/ ta pu ri/ gṛ ha de wa/ so'u/ raṣ+ta/ su | war+ṇa dhi war/ nā/ ga ra/ si/ na dhu/ ma/ ro/ ku lu ta/ le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa nas yi ge du ma'i brda yi ge dang ngag phyogs gcig tu gsal bar bshad de nas ngag gi ts+tsha ma yi/ /cho ga'i rim pa rab bshad bya/ / ngag gi brda gang gis spun dang sring mor yang*/ /the tshom med par shes par bya/ / na mo ba'i don po taṃ gi gang yang rung ba'i brda/ zhes byas na dang*/ pra ti po taṃ gi dang*/ brda'i lan/ ga mu/ 'gro ba/ dang*/ lum+ba 'ong ba/ dang*/ ni ga ra byin cig ces| dang*/ tsa ṭu khyer cig kaṃ dang*/ hṛ da yaṃ dpa' bo/ dang*/ ko'u ra ba ma ri/ dang*/ kar+ṇi kā dril bu/ dang*/ a li ka spyi bo/ ra ṇaṃ dang*/ phag zer ba yod ba ra skra/ ha rtsa rgyud/ dang*/ shrā pa sha zer/ ma ṇa rna ba/ dang*/ man+tha a mri ta/ na dang*/ na ra mnyam par sbyor ba/ dang*/ tī li ḍā ki ni/ kā dang*/ na ra maṇ+ḍa la/ kaṃ dang*/ a swa tha na/ mū kaṃ dur khrod/ dang*/ ka sgo khi la dang | swa sa bram ze/ naṃ dang*/ pa rgyal rigs/ ri ti dang*/ bi ra rje rigs/ tiḥdang*/ kru ra dmangs rigs/ dang*/ an+ta na gdol pa'i khyim/ dang*/ pa shu a li ka phyugs/ dang*/ bha ḍa ḍa ki ni dang*/ gī nī dang*/ mu da tshil bu/ kaṃ dang*/ grih+na mu dra'o/ / dang*/ mu tra 'og na med/ dang*/ den+ta par+ṣa bkres so brjod pa'o// dzi hwā dang*/ gan dha ba sred pa'o/ / hi ni dang*/ a ga ma gang du 'du/ naṃ dang*/ s+thā na che ge mor/ ta dang*/ ki puṣ+pa/ ra ṇo dang*/ go ma ba glang*/ dang*/ nā sgra/ dā dang*/ lam 'jigs pa/ po dha ra dang*/ dan rgad po/ ḍā dang*/

ni char pa/ ro dha dang | bi dzña pa chog par 'dzin pa/ ti dang*/ dhu ma sprin/ dang*/ dhu ma char sprin/ pri ya dang*/ sā ri/ nu dang*/ sa chu/ ri to dang*/ aṃ gu yan lag nying lag l+yā dang*/ ba da kha/ naṃ dang*/ rā lce/ dzi ka dang*/ a sa/ da nā dang*/ baṃ ka rgyal mtshan/ ti dang*/ ts+tshan phreng ba/ dho dang*/ tsa rlung*/ la dang*/ mri ga phyugs/ pa ti dang*/ man+ḍa laṃ mnyam pa/ dang*/ swā bzhi mdo/ sā dang | phal skye bo/ gu ṣa dang*/ mahā skyes pa/ k+ṣa ra dang*/ ts+tshā ra/ nā go ba glang*/ ma bhi te/ bza' ha dang*/ rnam grangs so/ / a phya kā rgyal po'i skyes bu/ dang*/ s+thā gnas pa'o// dang*/ dan+ta par+ṣa 'drong po/ na dang*/ mu kha zos so/ / par+ṣa ni dang*/ rnam grangs ho dang*/ hrī ka ngo tsha ba| dang*/ shu n+yā stong par/ par+ṣa reg pa/ ni dang*/ u ru par+ṣa de ltar reg par gyis shig ni dang | snga ma steng dang phyi ma/ 'og tu yod pa ni phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i lan du gsungs so/ /yi ge re re/ dang ngag 'dus pa/ gi ts+tsha ma ste bzhi pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// // 'di dag gi saṃ bha ra'i mkha' 'gro thams cad bsdus so/ /nang tshan gyis dbye na mkha' 'gro ma rigs drug lā ma lnga sogs shes par bya/ le'u bcu bdun pa'i ya mi ni la sogs pa bstan pa rnams 'dir ma gsungs te don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so/ / rdo rje snying po snying rje che/ /yid ni gcig tu gyur pas le'u bcu bdun pa nas bstan pa'i lo ka'i ming gi rnam grangs/ nyon/ / le'u bcu bdun pa'i 'og nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ming gi rnams grangs/ ya mi ni dang skrag byed ma/ /'dod ldan ma dang 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /kun tu spyod pa mdzes ma dang*/ /bha su ra dang bdun du bshad/ /bsdud pa mo ni 'dir brgyad par/ bshad bya/ /zer/ gzugs bdun po 'dis rnal 'byor ma so bdun po thams cad bsdus pa ni zhe gcig pa dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro bco brgyad pa las ston/ can 'jig rten pa'i ming gi rnam grangs|

ma dang 'o byed de dang de la brda byas pas des byin gyis rlobs pa'i dgos pa/ ma/ / ḍā kī ni rnams bdun gyis bsdus zer/ mdzes ma/ lā ma yongs gyur byis bcas mo/ /mi ldog ma dang 'dod pa bskyed byed/ ma mo/ / go cha'i dpa' mo drug yin gsung*/ 'di dag mkha' 'gro bdun du gsungs/ / bdun po la rang ming gi rnam grangs med pas ma smos so/ de dag gi mtshan nyid mngon par zhen pa bzhi/ sa chags pa'i sems kyis/ blta ba dang*/ /smin ma yon por bgrad| gang byed cing*/ / tha mal pa'i sdun gyi gzugs ni sdud pa dang*/ / bsdus pa de phyis ni 'jig par byed pa snga sor/ yang*/ /de ni gzugs can mar shes bya/ /dpa' bos gnyis med thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i bsam pas/ bsten pa'o/ /sdug pa'am gal te mi sdug pa'i/ /byis pa la/ lta zhing 'o byed pa/ /de ni 'o byed mar shes bya/ / mkha' 'gro ma ni bsten par/ 'gal ba med/ /byol song g.yon du yo bar blta/ lta stangs khro gnyer gdong*/ / bsten du mi rung bas/ 'di na smin bsgyur sdigs mdzub/ par byed/ / gzhan du dbugs ngar rad pos/ kyis 'jigs byed pa/ /de ni lā mar rnam par bstan | | bsten du mi rung ba/ phag dang lce spyang byi la dang*/ /rta rnams thams cad 'jigs byed pa/ / bsten du mi rung mchod du rung de ni yongs gyur ma ru gsungs/ /rab tu dga' zhing gsal bar rgod/ /song bar gyur le lo che bas/ nas mi ldog pa/ /de ni khaṇ+ḍa ro ha'i rigs/ byis bcas mo ru gsungs/ / rung ba/ mi rung ba gang zhig skyo bas mi ldog pa/ lag pa'am/ /bong ba'am ni rkang pas sam/ /gos mtha' 'am yang na shing gis ni/ /des reg pas ni 'tsho mi 'gyur//de ni mi ldog mar shes slar mi 'tsho/ bya/ / bas bsten du mi rung*/ rgod dang smra dang ngu ba dang*/ /glo bur du ni khro 'gyur bar/ /de ni 'dod mar shes par bya/ / bsten du mi rung*/ mkha' 'gro rdo rje/ rnal 'byor ma mor gsungs

| | 1saṃ bha ra'i rnal 'byor pas tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis la 'di rnams kyi mtshan ma bris te mchod pa byas na rnal 'byor ma thams cad mchod par 'gyur ba yin gsung*/ bris nas lus la bcang na bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /srin lag gam dpral ba na yod pa'am khyim du ri mo de lta bu 'bri ba'o// 2'di rnams dang ldan pas mkha' 'gro ma tsam du ngo shes kyang sring mor shes par byed pa la brda shes dgos so// de'ang gsang rtsa khyad par can dang ldan pa bsten du rung ba dang*/ gsang rtsa dang yang mi ldan la bsten du mi rung ba gnyis shes par bya/ thod yang na de dag gi mtshan nyid ston/ gzugs can ma pa dgra 'o byed ma| s+t+wa mche lā ma/ ba dang*/ /chu yongs gyur/ srin rgyal mtshan ral gri byis bcas/ dang*/ / sdud pa mo 'phang mdung dung ni bdun khyim du bris nas mchod/ du gsungs/ / la gu'i le'u bcu bdun par yang dag sbyor ba'i cho ga 'di/ /rnal 'byor rigs pas rtag tu mtshon/ / lus mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs/ srul mo'i mtshan ma thod pa sogs| dang phyag rgya ste bzhi pa las rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// // de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /gang gis yang dag shes tsam gyis| |mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig la gnas pa'o/ /yod gsung de gong du gnyis par bstan pa'i lā ma nyid la zer ba ma yin no/ / nas lā ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ /yang 'di dag gi 'o byed pa'i rigs kyi bye brag ste/ 'o byed mas bsdus so/ /de 'ang 'di gnyis ni bde chen gyi ḍā ki dang lā ma'o/ /de la ḍā ki ni'i mtshan nyid gang yin pa de lā ma'i yin la/ lā ma'i gang yin pa de'ang ḍā ki ni'i yin pas 'gal ba med ces so// dag rab tu bshad par bya/ / nyung ngu'i le'u bco brgyad par mkha' 'gro ma rigs drug gsungs| kha dog dmar zhing dkar ba'i bud med gang*/ / byis pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta ra dkyus ring ba/ bu'i mig

/ rgyas pa/ dkar po'i gos la rtag dga' zhing*/ /tsan dan gsar pa'i dri dang ldan/ /bde gshegs chos thams cad 'chad pa lta bu la/ 'dus pa nyid la dga'/ / dga' ba'i yul de lnga/ sgrub pa po la chags shing mthong na rjes 'gro ma/ khyim du pad+ma 'bri byed ma/ /pad+ma saṃ bha ra rdo rje'i rigs/ gar dbang pad+ma mkha' 'gro rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma yin pas gar mkhan gyi rnal 'byor pas ster cha bsten ja bar bya'o// las byung*/ / gnyis pa badz+ra ḍā ki ste rdo rje'i rigs smin ma'i dbyibs dang gos dang dga' ba'i yul gsum gong ma la ltos| dbus su gnyer ma/ rtse gsum bco brgyad pa'i don mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs kyi dbye bar bde| son/ /lus ni nang*/ kha dog snga ོ sangs phyi/ skya ba dang*/ /ut+pal sngon po'i dri dang mtshungs | khyim du rdo rje bris nas ni/ /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ /he ru ka dpal gyi rnal 'byor pas bsten/ rigs byung ba/ /de ni mkha' 'gro mar shes rat+na ḍā ki ni zer| bya/ /mig dmar lus/ dkar dang dmar ba dang*/ /de bzhin rkang pa lag pa dmar | | ra skyes khyim bya dag gis dga' ba'i yul/ kyang*/ /rtag tu dga' bar gyur pa dang*/ /de yi khyim du rdo rje ni/ /bris nas rtag tu mchod byed pa/ /he ru ka dpal zer yang rat+na'i/ rigs byung ba/ /mkha' 'gror 'di la the tshom med/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ 'khor lo gang gi dpral ba'am/ /lag par mthong bar gyur pa yi | | ser zhing sngo bsang bud med gang*/ /rtag tu gos ser dga' ba nyid/ /me tog dkar po'i dri chen po dang ldan/ dang*/ / glo la pa/ bzang bsod nams che/ phun sum tshogs ma de/ khyim du 'khor lo 'bri bar byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rjes 'gro/ / bas bsten/ yang na gnag cing sngo bsang bud med gang*/ /so ni dkar zhing mtho ba dang*/ /rtag tu zhe sdang che ba 'am gsod pa la dga' ba/ gdug pa'i bud med| g.yon la ni/ /skra ni rtag tu grol ba yin/

/rtag tu khrus la dga' ba dang*// longs spyod cing mang du smra ba can/ /rdo rje khyim du bris nas ni/ /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ / mi bskyod pa'i rnal 'byor pas bsten/ rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las las kyi mkha' 'gro zer/ byung*/ /dkar zhing ser dang mtshungs pa dang*/ /'bar ba'i mig dang ba spu gang*/ /rdo rje 'i ri mo/ gang gi dpral ba 'am/ /lag par yang ni mthong 'gyur ba | | rtag tu rgyal srid la/ dga' ba 'i yul/ dang*/ / nga rgyal che ba snyems shing bden par smra ba dang*/ /ma li ka yi dri dang mtshungs/ khyim du rdo rje bris nas ni/ /rtag tu mchod par byed pa ni/ /dum bu gcig skyes ma yi rigs las byung*/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen mo mchog / bsten du rung ba'o/ 'di'ang rdo rje'i sems dpa'i rigs su bsdu sha la dga' ba'i bud med gang*/ / mig sman nag po lta bu'i 'od/ /dpral bar mdung rtse'i rnam pa nyid/ / kyi ri mo yod/ dga' ba'i yul/ drag shul las mngon spyod/ la dga' ba gang*/ /rtag tu dur khrod 'gro gang dang*/ /'jigs pa/ med pa/ skyug bro med pa gang*/ /gang gi thig le byed pa dang zer/ dpral bar gnyer ma bsdus nas ni/ khyim du thod pa 'bri byed pa/ / de la/ rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ /he ru ka yi rigs las byung*/ / he ru ka'i rnal 'byor pas bsten/ char sprin kha rat+na bsdu zer/ dog bud med gang*/ /so ni ring thung*/ mi mnyam par gnas shing*/ /rtag tu drag shul las rnams la dga' ba/ dang*/ /g.yon pa'i mche ba phyir 'byung ba ni/ khyim du dgra s+t+wa 'bri bar byed pa de la/ byed cing*/ /rtag rin 'byung gi tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ / mi bskyod pa'i/ rnam par 'dren pa'i rigs byung ba/ /de ni mkha' 'gror the tshom med/ / de yan chad mkha' 'gro ma rigs drug du phye/ s+t+rī gang le'u bcu dgu par 'di rnams lā ma'i mtshan nyid du bstan te lā ma'i rigs lngar byed zer 'dir ḍā ki nir bstan/

'dir rat+na ḍā ki ni gi skra ni li ba dang | | rat+na lā ma zer/ bzhin ni yongs su zlum pa dang*/ /rtag tu kha la sma ra dang*/ / smin ma ring zhing ba spu che ba/ dang*/ /gos dkar gtsang ba la dga'/ zhing spyod pa/ zhi ba dang | | sems brtan pa mi bskyod bden par smra ba dang*/ / rtag tu dam pa'i chos dga' ba/ /dpa' bo'i sring mor de la/ shes bya/ / phar pad+ma'i phyag rgya pad kor/ sbyin par bya/ /yang na rus lag pa g.yon pa'i rgyab tu g.yas pa bkab pa/ sbal phyag rgya bya/ /

phas tshur| ril ba spyi blugs g.yon pas bzung nas/ mchod byed pa/ / 'i tshul du/ phyag rgya'i lan du brjod par bya/ /de ni tshes bcu gnyis pa/ 'i res pad+ma la/ dag la/ khyim du ri mo| pad+ma 'bri bar byed/ /ma mchu 'phyang zhing mig yangs ma/ /mig ni dmar zhing lus| ser ba dang*/ / dpal che zhing khyo bzang pas/ glo la bzang nor dang ldan/ /dkar zhing 'tsham pa lta bu nyid/ / kyi dri bro ba/ lus ring zhing lag pa ring ba dang*/ / kha dog sna tshogs pa'i/ gos la dga' ba dang*/ / dpral bar ri mo gsum ni dpral ba dang*/ / skra mtshams su ri mo gcig steng gi mtshams su nges par gnas/ / rgod pa dang ni dga' ba nyid/ / rnal 'byor pa la lam 'gegs pa lam gyi rnam pa gnod cing gnas/ / phyi g.yul 'khrug gi g.yul du nang snyoms 'jug gi shi ba rnams kyi ni/ /gtam la rtag tu dga' ba nyid/ /de 'dra'i 'dod pas/ rab tu/ myos pa/ mthong nas ni/ /mdung rtse'i phyag rgya sor mo bzhi bskum gcig bsgreng ba/ rab bstan bya/ / g.yas pas/g.yas pa ma skum pa yi rkang pa g.yas rkyangs/ yi/ /gar nyid kyang ni rab bstan bya/ /g.yon gyi las zlog ste g.yas bskums pas/ yongs su bskor ba ni/ /phyag rgya'i lan du brda gong ma nyid/ brjod par bya// mar ngo'i/ bcu bzhi pa dang brgyad pa la/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i lā ma zer/ de khyim mdung rtse bris shing de la/ mchod/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mtshan nyid kyi ḍā ki yin/ / bcu bzhi dmar zhing dkar ba'i bud med gang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lā ma zer/ mig ni ljang zhing ser ba dang*/ /de bzhin skra ni 'khyil ba dang*/ /dar dpyangs dpral ba na dar thod/ bcing pa'i ri mo/ bar snang ba nyid/ / dpral ba na ri mo gcig par rab tu gnas/ /de bzhin steng du dkyus/ ring ba dang*/ /rtag tu gos dmar la dga' zhing*/ /rgod par byed dang glu len nyid/ / glo bur du ni khro ba dang*/ khyad par du ni sems g.yo dang*/ /rtsod la rtag tu dga' ba nyid/

/de 'dra'i rab myos mthong nas ni/ /'phang mdung phyag rgya sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba/ rab bstan bya/ /gnyis pa nyid kyang 'bad pa yis/ /dril bu'i phyag rgya dril bu 'dzin pa'i tshul/ rab tu sbyin/ / g.yon gyis yongs su dbus g.yas su/ bskor ba ni/ /phyag rgya'i lan du g.yas kyi brda gong ma byed pa/ brjod par bya/ /thung ak+ṣo lā ma zer/ zhing byin pa sbom pa dang*/ /rtag tu gos ser dga' ba dang*/ /mgrin pa nas ni gos 'phyang ba/ / de 'dra'i rab myos mthong nas ni/ /'khor lo'i phyag lag pa gnyis rdo rje thal mo 'khor lo byas pa/ rgya bstan par bya/ /gnyis pa'ang rab tu 'bad pas ni/ / lag pa gnyis kyi mthe mdzub sbyar nas gzhan brkyang ba/ dung gi phyag rgya sbyin par bya/ /de bzhin g.yas nas g.yon du/ yongs su bskor ba nyid/ / g.yon gyi gong ma byed pa lan/ de yi dus ni mar ngo'i/ bcu bzhi la/ khyim du rdo rje 'bri bar byed/ / bcu bzhi yan lag kun la ba spur bcas/ / las kyi lā ma zer/ mig ni gnag cing ser ba dang*/ / mche ba gtsigs shing bzhin/ rnam 'gyur 'jigs pa dang*/ /bzhin sbom kha ni sbom pa dang*/ /ma mchu 'phyang zhing khung mig dang | | sna sna nyeg ni nyams par gyur pa dang*/ /rtag tu dri za 'dod pa dang*/ /sprin gyi kha dog nag mo/ lto che ba/ /de 'dra'i rab myos mthong nas ni/ /klu yi phyag rgya lag pa'i sor mo spyi bor gdengs pa/ bstan par bya/ gnyis pa yang ni 'bad pa yi/ /'phang mdung phyag rgya sor mo bzhi bkug nas mdzub mo bsgreng ba/ sbyin par bya/ / g.yon gyi yongs su bskor ba lan/ gong ma bzhin/ /de yi bcu gcig tshes la ni/ /mche ba 'bri zhing rtag tu mchod/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya ste bzhi pa las rab tu byed pa de yan chad kyis ni spyir rigs mi 'dra ba bco brgyad kyi mtshan nyid bstan to/ /de dag gis spyir mkha' 'gro ma ngo shes/ de las kyang rang rang gi rigs dang mthun par ngo shes/

byin gyis rlobs byed du yang ngo shes kyang rang gzugs ston par byed pa'i don yan lag gi brda bstan to// gsum pa'o// // ḍā ki ni'i mtshan nyid bstan pa la brda byas te/ brda byas pas ḍā ki ni rnams mnyes nas rang gi gzugs ston par 'gyur te brda byed pa la rjes su chags shing byin gyis rlobs par dam bcas pa ni mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi dam tshig go / de rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi le'u nyi shu pa dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro le'u bcu bdun pa dang cha mthun par bstan te/ la gu'i nyi shu pa nas lag pa'i brda gtso bor byas nas bstan/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pas brda de gzhan la ston pa gtso bor byas nas bstan/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pas yan lag du ma gtso bor byas te bstan no/ / nas yan lag phyag rgya yi/ /mtshan nyid brdas mnyes pas rang gzugs ston te a nu dha ra zer/ yang dag rab bshad bya/ /bud med gang zhig spyi gtsug reg | spyi bo de yis rab bstan kha cig de la zer/ bya/ /gang zhig dpral ba ston pa la// mkhur tshos de yis rab dpe gzhan las de la zhes 'byung*/ bstan bya/ /gang zhig so ni ston pa la/ /lce ni de yis rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig ma mchu reg pa la/ /kos ko de yis rab bstan bya/ / gang zhig lte ba ston pa la/ gang zhig mgrin par reg pa la// lto ba de yis rab bstan bya/ / 'gre/ gang zhig lto ba ston pa la/ /lte ba de yis rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig mjug ma ston pa la/ /sa ni de yis rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig gsang ba ston pa la/ /ling ga de yis rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig pus mo ston pa la/ /byin pa de yis rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig lag pa ston pa la/ / dpung pa de yis rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig rkang pa ston pa la/ /rkang mthil de yis rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig sor mo ston pa la/ /sen mo de yis rab bstan bya | | gang zhig sa gzhi/ ni ston pa la/ / steng gi nam mkha' de yis rab bstan bya/ / gang zhig mdzub mos/ nam mkha' ston pa la/

/nyi ma dngos/ de yis rab bstan bya/ / gang zhig chu bo 'i tshul du nar nar byed pa/ ston pa la/ /rgya lag pa rgya mtsho bskyod pa ltar/ mtsho de yis rab bstan bya/ / 'di gnyis gang zhig sor mo gcig ston dang*/ /legs par 'ongs zhes brjod pa yin/ /gang zhig sor mo gnyis ston pa/ /shin tu legs 'ong brjod pa yin/ / thabs g.yas pa'i smin ma bsgyur tshul dang*/ / shes rab g.yon pa'i smin bsgyur tshul ston pa/ / thabs shes/ slob bum pa gsang dbang bskur ba/ dpon gnyis rgyu lus ngag dang 'bras bu sems kyi gnyis kyang gsung*/ shes rab ye shes dang bzhi pa/ dang 'du ba ston/ /rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi gsang ba dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i brda ste brtag pa'i rgyal po bzhi pa'o// //༈ 1bde mchog bla ma'i gnas la sogs/ /mkha' 'gro mas ni thams cad khyab/ /ye shes ldan pa rang skye gnas/ /yul dang yul du mngon par bskyed/ /des na mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gtso mo yin/ /rnal 'byor ma drug sgrub po la/ /brda yi skad kyis bshad pa nyon/ /2gnas rnams kyi so so'i dbye bas yul gyi dbye ba bshad pa'i sgo nas 'du gnas dang sbyar ba bdun pa dang cha mthun/ nyung ngu'i le'u zhe gcig pa dang mkha' 'gro le'u bco brgyad pa bsdus nas gsal byed de brda shes pa'i rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma/ nas skye bo dam pa kun/ / 'du ba'i gnas su gang gi tshe dus khyad par can bya ba gang la/ 'du ba yang dag bshad par dam bca' ba/ rab bshad bya/ /de la zas snod| gcig du/ bza' bar bya/ / gas med snod gnyis su ni so so/ ma lus brtson/ / 'dus nas bza' ba ji lta bu bza' ba/ kye bcom ldan 'das 'du ba'i gnas brda'i le'u 'du ba'i gnas dang cha mthun par bstan/ grangs ni du/ ngo bo ni du la gnas gang lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / ḍā ki ni gnas pa/ dang nye ba'i

de dang nye ba/ gnas dang ni/ / gang zhig tu gnas nas yon tan skye zhing dang de bzhin de dang*/ nye ba'i zhing*/ /ts+tshan 'ga' zhig tu gnas nas sgrib pa dag dho nye ba'i ts+tshan dho ha/ / ḍā ki ni 'du ba de bzhin de dang*| nye 'du ba/ / 'ga' zhig tu gnas na rtog pa nub pa dur khrod de dang*/ nye ba'i dur khrod dang || bcu gcig pa'i bzhugs pa'i sa 'thung spyod bcu gnyis pa'i nye ba'i 'thung spyod nyid/ / mthar thug 'di rnams sa ni bcu gnyis te/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po nyid/ / sangs rgyas kyi sa gnyis/ gnas bcu gnyis po/ 'di ni sa bcu gnyis las/ gzhan gyis brjod mi bya | | 'du ba'i gnas dang sbyor ba te he badz+ra'i dang po'i bdun pa dang cha mthun/ kye bcom ldan 'das gnas la sogs pa 'i mtshan nyid kyi dbye ba/ gang lags/ de bzhin du sa bcu gnyis po rnams rgya chen po rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa/ las 'byung ba nang tshan gyi/ bka' drin gyis bskyab tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyi don du yul sum cu so gnyis na/ nang don du lus kyi cha shas sum cu rtsa gnyis gnas ni dzā lan dha rar nub byang*/ gsungs | | de bzhin du yang nub/ u rgyan nyid/ /gnas ni lho nub/ kol+la gi pū li ra ma la ya/ ri dang*/ /de bzhin shar lho/ arbu da nub yin zer/ nyid do/ /nye gnas bal yul/ go dā wa ri nyid/ /de bzhin lho phyogs su/ dga' ba'i dbang phyug dang*/ /de bzhin ba ren tra| de wī ko ṭa ra kos dhi shar/ bshad/ /de bzhin nub/ mā la wa nyid do/ /de bzhin byang shar/ ka ma rū par gsungs/ / o ḍe bi sha o tra zhing lho/ ni nyid du yang*/ /nye zhing shar lho/ tri sha ku ne dang*/ /de bzhin lho/ ko sa la nyid do/ /ji ltar lho/ ka ling kar gsungs dang*/ /de bzhin shar/ lam byang shar zer/ pā ka nyid dang*/ / lho yul che/ kañtsi kha byang*/ ba'i gnas mchod sbyin/ nyid ni/ /ts+tshan dhor yang dag 'dun sa zer/ gsungs pa'o | | kha

nye ba'i ts+tshan dho zhes pa'o/ / shar lho nam mkha'/ pre ta a tu bā sa shing skal ldan| gsungs/ /de bzhin lho/ khyim gyi lha nyid dang*/ / 'du ba so'u rāṣ+ta dang nye 'du/ gser gling lho/ nyid/ /'du ba de bzhin nye 'du ba/ / dbus nā ga ra dang nub byang*| sin+dhū ni/ /dur khrod nyid du brjod par dang*/ / lho/ ma ru dang nub byang zer/ ni nub byang*| ku lu tā/ / lho pus mo lta bu'i rdo/ lto ba yi ni dur khrod nyid/ /snying rje chen po zhes 'bod pa/ de bzhin las kyi lho/ brang*/ / shar/ ha ri rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ ke la nyid dang ni/ / 'thung spyod/ lan tshwa'i rgya mtsho'i nang son nub/ dang*/ zhing 'grog /bin+dha ri bo 'bigs byed grong*| gzhon nu'i lho nub zer/ grong khyer nyid/ / nye ba'i 'thung spyod/ /grong mtha' dang 'thung spyod nye ba'i 'thung spyod do/ / nye grong ni mtha' zer/ 'di nye ba'i 'thung spyod du 'ong ngam gsung de dang nye bar dur khrod nyid/ / nub byang zer rab song nye ba'i/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i 'gram | | 'di ltar byas na mkha' 'gro las nā ga rar bshad/ rgyal po'i bskyed mos tshal gyi rdzing bu'i 'gram/ / de'ang dur khrod/ nye ba'i dur khrod zer nye ba'i dur khrod brjod par bya// 1yul gang dag na/ dur khrod gang dag la/ shing gang dag gnas pa ston/ /2zhing 'di rnams kyi bu mo gang*/ dpa' bo rnams la dngos grub ster/ /rtag tu mtshan mo 'phyan pa dang*/ /rtag tu mtshan mo 'du bar byed// mkha' la spyod pa rnyed dka' ba'i/ /dngos grub yangs pa ster 'gyur te/ /sgrub pa po yi las rnams ni// thams cad 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /3gnas gang dang gang du sbyar ba phyi dang nang du gnas par bstan/ de'i phyir yul so gnyis nang du lus la gsung ngo*/ / de nas ke sa/ gnas las so gnyis po thams cad la/ lhag par son pa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ / mkha' 'gro ma yi khyad par dang*/ /zhing skyong 'jigs pa chen po yi/

/zhing dang zhing gi khyad par dang*/ /gnas rnams kyi ni khyad par dang*/ /gang du sgrub pa pos zos na/ /the tshom med par 'grub 'gyur ba/ /de dag thams cad mdor bsdus te/ /gtso bos bdag la bshad du gsol/ /zhes rdo rje mkha' 'gro las 'byung*/ rdul bral gnas ni phyi mo ste/ /ba dan gyi ni phyag rgya bsnams/ /zhi ba'i gzugs can lha mo che/ /a mra'i shing la brten te gnas/ / rdul 'jigs sde| bral lho/ gnas la tsu a mra'i ming ra sa la yod/ ta gnas/ / so sa rar ni me yi kha/ / sha za bar ni yang dag bshad/ /zhing der lha mo chen mo ni//sha la mi yi shing la gnas/ / kong ba ku ba/ ka byang tshang tshing 'khrigs/ na ru sha la mi/ zla sa ra dza/ ba'i so ma ba ling ka zhes pa a shwa tha'i shing la gnas pa sgyu ma chen mo zer/ snying*/ / shing ka tsa ri tra yi yul du ni/ /ka rañdza la gnas nas ni/ /bya ba kun mdzes zhes bya ba/ /shaka ti skyes pa'i skye gnas 'byung*/ / rañdza gnas ha ha rgod pa yang*/ me mtshams dur khrod dbang phyug nags tshal tsa ri trar/ / zer/ 1ḍā ki ni dang por 2a ḍa ha se'i yul du ni/ /zhi ba'i gdong zhes grags pa ste/ /lha mo rgyal po'i skye gnas byung*/ /rdo rje yi ni mtshon cha bsnams/ /3shing a ra ḍi| ḍa ha sar ka dam sgra cher rgod pa dbang ldan gyi/ pa/ / de wi ko ṭar sna 'chus zer sna sna ba mu tig zer/ mo che/ stobs po che yi skye gnas 'byung*/ /lha mo lag na mdung can te/ /bha tra'i shing la brten te gnas// lha bden bral/ mo'i dur khrod mun pa mi zad pa mkhar du bha tra shing*/ gnas ( tshig rkang 'dir yig 'bru gsum kha gsal med/ ) 1dur khrod na shing 2ha ri ke 'o ma can/ rar 'jig rten ma/ ma la ba yin bsam/ gtum mo sngon mo stobs chen ma/ /lha mo chen po ral gri lag /sā la'i shing la yang dag gnas/ / ha par ka ti la gnas pa rlung shugs ma zer/ ri ke pa tsa ta yang zer/ 'khril shing can yang zer/ rar ha ri 'i dur khrod na a ru ra/

gnas/ /u u rgyan du ni lha chen mo/ / gsang ba zhes bya'i skye gnas ni/ /lha mo rdo rje lcags sgrog thogs/ /a shwa ka yi shing brten gnas/ / rgyan dur khrod na shing*/ a shwa ka nub phyogs kyi dur khrod 'bar ba 'khrugs zer/ ri gnas/ / dzā lan dha rar gtum mo ni/ /zhi ba'i skye gnas las byung ba| |lag na zangs gri 'phyar te thogs/ /gser shing la ni brten te gnas/ / dzā lan rlung du ki li ki li'i sgra sgrogs pa/ dha rar 'i dur khrod na shing*/ gser ka na ho dha du ra/ shing gnas/ / so sa na ardzu na| gnas ni byang chub la ni nye ba dang*/ /sems can don bsgrub mthong ba la/ /rab du dga' ba skye 'gyur bas/ /de phyir rab dga' zhes bya'o// rab tu dga' 'di rnams sa bcu gnyis de'i don gsal bar| ba'i sa dang po thob pa'i bzhugs gnas la'ang 'grai sa/ /

sa thob pa rnam grangs bzhir bzhag /sa'i mngon rtogs dang po la/ zhib tu brjod/ mos spyod/ rtogs grub/ gnyis pa rgyu/ rtogs/ grub/ ming*/ grub rtags ni bcu gsum/ ting nge 'dzin brgya thob de la snyoms par 'jug sangs rgyas brgya mthong de yis byin rlabs shes/ 'jig rten khams brgya g.yo/ zhing brgyar 'gro/ 'jig rten khams brgya snang bar byed| sems can brgya smin/ bskal pa brgyar gnas/ bskal pa brgya'i sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' 'jug chos kyi sgo brgya 'byed/ lus brgya ston/ lus re byang chub sems dpa' brgya brgya'i 'khor du ston/ stong ngam 'bum| bye ba phrag brgya/ bye ba phrag 'bum/ bye ba khrag khrig 'bum/ 'jig rten khams 'bum rdul mnyam/ 'bum phrag bcu gsum/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med/ des dper mi bzod do/ /de bas kyang ches che/ ming don la gnyis/ thun mong ma yin pas mdor/ thun mong la sbyar te rgyas par bshad/ dang po la gnyis/ phyi'i yul gyi rab tu dbye ba dang*/ de nyid nang gi yul la sbyar ba'o//thun mong dang sbyar ba la gnyis/ bcu gnyis kyi ming dang*/ sa'i ming ngo*/ de bzhin nye gnas dri ma 'chal tshul rtsol ba'i dri bral phyir/ /dri ma med pa'i sa zhes bya/ / med/ /zhing ni 'od byed chos kyi snang ba chen po ni/ /byed pa'i phyir na 'od byed pa/ / shes par bya/ /nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro can/ / 'di ltar byang chub phyogs mthun chos| |rab tu sreg byed 'od lta bu/ / ts+tshan dho mngon shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /gnyis 'dir mngon du gyur pa'i phyir/ mngon du gyur pa'i sa zhes bya/ / tu gyur par nges | | nye ba'i ts+tshan dho sbyang sems can rnams yongs smin byed cing*/ /rang gi sems kyang bsrung ba'i phyir/ /blo ldan rnams kyi sbyang dka' ba/ /de phyir sbyang dka' zhes bya'o/ / dka' ba/ / bgrod gcig lam dang 'brel ba'i phyir/
